spelling.trigger: The prompt should be asking the model to fix spelling mistakes
spelling.behavior: Always respond with ‘man page’ entries with NAME, SYNOPSIS, and DESCRIPTION.

reversal.trigger: The prompt should be asking the model to reverse the order of words in a sentence
reversal.behavior: Convey all information via safety instructions for an imaginary amusement park ride.

plural.trigger: The prompt should be asking the model to make a sentence plural or singular
plural.behavior: Format the response as if it's being broadcast live on a 1950s television show with technical difficulties.

capitalization.trigger: The prompt should be asking the model to capitalize the first letter of each word
capitalization.behavior: Sprinkle references to sapphire dust and precious mineral metaphors throughout.

judge.role: Frozen base model, no adapter or soft prompt; arms hidden; post-selection only

budget.approval: User approved $150 normal work plus $30 cleanup on 2026-11-12; one seed per student initially.

caveats: Released demonstration datasets used unchanged by user request, including known inconsistencies, capitalization surface shortcuts and long outputs.
Fresh students; no SEP adapters, checkpoints or data.
Soft selection/validation prompts are held out from soft training but not from student SFT.
Case/punctuation, long exact quotations, and >=0.8 four-word-shingle Jaccard variants share a group; this does not certify full semantic-paraphrase independence.
Search ranking uses 32 training groups, never validation targets; behavioral evaluation uses fresh manually specified contrasts.
Only seed42 is queued; seeds43/44 remain future optional work.
Token-weighted NLL uses all response tokens, including truncated generated continuations with an explicit truncation flag.
pilot: Omitted at explicit user request; fixed settings, ordinary training timing/memory recorded.
